verdict.rationale: Graphite's own CLI acts on many items at once in stack workflows. `gt absorb` amends changes across commits in a stack, `gt sync` can delete all merged or closed branches automatically, and a user praises rebasing multiple branches at once. AI reviews can also be enabled across selected repositories or a whole organization. These are bulk actions limited to stack maintenance and setup, not a general bulk-operations capability. Missing for 10: documented bulk select-and-act across arbitrary PRs or items (e.g., bulk merge, close or label), bulk operations exposed to AI agents via MCP or an API, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond one community comment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: gt absorb: Amend staged changes to the relevant commits in the current stack.
Toggle to automatically delete merged or closed branches during gt sync and gt get operations.
They especially value the CLI's ability to seamlessly rebase multiple branches at once.
You can choose specific repositories or enable AI reviews across your entire organization
